entries.title: Romans 16:1
segments: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, who is a minister of the church at Cenchrae.

entries.title: Romans 16:2
segments: I beg you to give her a Christian welcome, as the saints should; and to assist her in any matter in which she may have need of you. For she herself has been made an overseer to many people, including myself.

entries.title: Romans 16:3
segments: Salute Priscilla and Aquila, my fellow laborers in the cause of Jesus Christ,

entries.title: Romans 16:4
segments: who risked their own lives to save mine; who are thanked not only by me,

entries.title: Romans 16:5
segments: but by all the churches among the Gentiles. Salute likewise the church that meets in their home. Salute Epaenetus, my dearly beloved, the first man in Roman Asia to believe in Christ.

entries.title: Romans 16:6
segments: Salute Mary, who toiled terribly for you;

entries.title: Romans 16:7
segments: and Andronicus and Junia, my kinsfolk and fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, and who became Christians before I did.

entries.title: Romans 16:8
segments: Salute Amplias, my beloved in the Lord;

entries.title: Romans 16:9
segments: and Urbanus, my fellow toiler in Christ; and Stachys, my dear, dear friend.

entries.title: Romans 16:10
segments: Salute Apellas, tested and tried in Christ, and the household of Aristobulus,

entries.title: Romans 16:11
segments: and Herodion, my kinsman. Salute the believing members of the household of Narcissus.

entries.title: Romans 16:12
segments: Salute Trypheana and Tryphosa, who are ever toiling in the Lord. Salute dear Persis, who has toiled terribly in the Lord's service.

entries.title: Romans 16:13
segments: Salute Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

entries.title: Romans 16:14
segments: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are associated with them.

entries.title: Romans 16:15
segments: Salute Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, Olympas, and all the saints associated with them.

entries.title: Romans 16:16
segments: Salute one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ salute you.

entries.title: Romans 16:17
segments: I exhort you, brothers, to keep watch of those who are causing the divisions among you, and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the teaching which you have learned.

entries.title: Romans 16:18
segments: Turn away from them. For men of that stamp are not the slaves of Christ, but are slaves to their own appetites. By their smooth and fair speech they beguile the hearts of the innocent.

entries.title: Romans 16:19
segments: I say this, for the tidings of your obedience have been told throughout the world. On your own behalf, then, I rejoice; but I want you to be wise unto the good, but innocents in evil.

entries.title: Romans 16:20
segments: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

entries.title: Romans 16:21
segments: Timothy, my fellow worker, salutes you; so do my fellow countrymen Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.

entries.title: Romans 16:22
segments: I, Tertius, who write this letter, salute you in the Lord.

entries.title: Romans 16:23
segments: Gaius, my host, and the host of the church, salutes you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, salutes you, and so does brother Quartus.

entries.title: Romans 16:24
segments: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all!

entries.title: Romans 16:25
segments: Now I commend you to Him who is able to keep you stedfast, according to my gospel, and the proclamation of Jesus Christ, whereby is unveiled the secret truth which was kept secret through immemorial ages,

entries.title: Romans 16:26
segments: but now has been brought to light, and by command of the eternal God made known to the Gentiles by the scriptures of the Prophets, so that the Gentiles might hold obedience of the faith.

entries.title: Romans 16:27
segments: Unto Him, the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, be glory forever. Amen.
